term_semantics.counterfactual_sensitivity: one when the base support fact is absent from evidence
term_semantics.entity_presence: one when either claim entity ID is absent from evidence
term_semantics.polarity: one when matching directed evidence has the opposite polarity
term_semantics.quantity_unit_agreement: one when matching directed evidence disagrees on quantity or unit
term_semantics.relation_role_agreement: one when present entities lack the claimed directed relation

field_principles.counterfactual_fixture_ready_score: The exact field gates generation on corpus integrity, not expected performance.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured build time reveals truncated fixture generation.
field_principles.energy_term_contract: A frozen auditable energy prevents post-outcome score tuning.
field_principles.entity_evidence_rows: Entity and span anchors expose localization failures hidden by aggregate labels.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host execution prevents any model or board attribution.
field_principles.field_principles: Field reasons distinguish fixture integrity from future verifier performance.
field_principles.frozen_fixture_ids: Stable IDs let later tasks reproduce the exact paired schedule.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked artifact records the missing input and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal text reports fixture readiness only and makes no verifier-value claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use exact_source_fixture_construction for deterministic labeled data work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use cpu_exact_solver_or_simulator, or blocked_no_run before construction, because no model is loaded.
field_principles.mutation_test_rows: Term-level mutations show which constraint fired and why.
field_principles.perturbation_rows: Paired mutations provide the causal test of evidence sensitivity.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Input and license receipts prove the fixture was built from available admissible sources.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes split and perturbation construction reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum catches source, split, or contract drift.
field_principles.rows: One row per base example, condition, and perturbation makes all comparisons reconstructable.
field_principles.run_date: The date binds the corpus to the source and split versions used.
field_principles.sealed_field_rows: Sealing receipts prove evaluation truth cannot enter prompts or scores.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind every derived row to its source inputs.
field_principles.source_family_rows: Family coverage prevents one template from carrying the result.
field_principles.split_rows: Explicit split membership prevents calibration leakage into evaluation.
field_principles.status: A terminal state prevents an unfinished corpus from gating generation.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial for structural aggregation.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False records that exact labels are separate from the frozen candidate energy.
